docs.title: Manufacture of thin film transistor
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the operating efficiency of manufacturing a thin film transistor by forming a metal film when forming source.drain electrodes, and then heat treating it prior to patterning to cause a boundary reaction between an ohmic contact layer and the metal film as a low resistance layer unnecessary for patterning the metal film. CONSTITUTION:After a chromium deposited film is formed on a glass substrate 1, a gate electrode 2 is formed, and a gate insulating film 3 is formed. An amorphous silicon I-type layer 4 is formed, the polyimide film of an upper insulating film 6 is formed, and an image G of the electrode 2 is focused in a positive resist 9. It is developed to form an upper insulating film 6, an amorphous silicon n<+>type layer is deposited, the amorphous silicon n<+>type layer is selectively removed together with the resist pattern 9, an aluminum deposited film 7' is formed, and heat treated to form an Al-Si layer 10 only at a boundary from the amorphous silicon n<+>type layer. Source, drain electrodes and wiring layers 7, 8 are eventually formed, and the outer edges of the amorphous silicon I-type layer, N<+> type layer and an Al-Si layer are removed by etching.

docs.title: Manufacture of thin film semiconductor device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To form an insulating film which has an excellent boundary characteristic by keeping a glass substrate at a specific temperature or lower and at the same time depositing an insulating newer thereon and then applying heat treatment thereto in a specific range of temperature. CONSTITUTION:An a-Si film is formed on a glass substrate 1 and then is crystallized by annealing using a excimer laser to obtain a Poly-Si film, and then the Poly-Si film is patterned in land-like form by a photolithographic method to obtain a semiconductor active layer 2 having an inclination of 30 deg. or less at the end thereof. A silicon oxide film is deposited at a substrate temperature of 23 deg.C with the use of an ECR plasma CVD method, and then is heated at 500 deg.C in the atmosphere of nitrogen for an hour to deposit Ta, and patterning is applied thereto to form a gate electrode 5, and phosphorus is injected thereinto to form a source region 3a and a drain region 3b which are self-aligned. Therefore, the boundary level of a gate insulating film is lowered to improve the boundary characteristic, so that a thin films semiconductor device with high reliability may be realized.

docs.title: Piezoelectric film and piezoelectric element provided with same
docs.abstract: Provided are a piezoelectric film having high piezoelectric characteristics and a piezoelectric element provided with the piezoelectric film. In the piezoelectric film that includes a perovskite-type oxide represented by general formula P, 0.1≤x≤0.3 and 0<y≤0.49x are satisfied. A 1+δ [(Zr, Ti) 1-x-y Nb x Sc y ]O z  ··· general formula P. In general formula P, A represents a site A element in which Pb is a main component, and δ=0 and z=3 are standard. These standard values can be deviated from as long as the values fall within a range which can achieve the perovskite structure.

docs.title: Anisotropic conductive film and manufacture thereof
Composition for forming underlayer film in imprint method, kit, pattern forming method, multilayer body, and method for producing semiconductor element
docs.abstract: A composition for forming an underlayer film in an imprint method, which contains a polymer compound having a polymerizable functional group and a monomer having a plurality of crosslinkable functional groups that are linkable with a polymerizable functional group, wherein: the Hansen solubility parameter distance, which is the difference between the Hansen solubility parameter of the polymer compound and the Hansen solubility parameter of the monomer, is 5.0 or less; and with respect to two crosslinkable functional groups among the plurality of crosslinkable functional groups, the number of atoms that constitute the shortest atomic chain which connects the crosslinking points in the crosslinkable functional groups with each other is 7 or more. A multilayer body which comprises a layer that is formed from this composition for forming an underlayer film; and a method for producing a semiconductor element, wherein a semiconductor element is produced by utilizing a pattern that is obtained by the above-described pattern forming method.

docs.title: Sputtering device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To form a thin film uniform in thickness even if a target is short in the magnetron-type continuous sputtering device by the passage film forming method by dividing the target and providing a magnetic field generating means capable of impressing an independent sputtering voltage in each section. CONSTITUTION:A substrate holder 7 is continuously moved to the right in the figure and transferred to a sputtering chamber 15, and a thin film is formed on the substrates A, B and C successively mounted on the holder 7 while rotating a table 6. In this device, the rectangular target 1 extending orthogonally to the right-hand side in the figure is horizontally arranged and divided into the central target 16 and the targets 1a and 1c on both ends. A discrete target power source 4 is connected to each target to impress a sputtering power on each target, however the sputtering power to be impressed on the targets 1a and 1c is made higher than that on the target 1b.

docs.title: Manufacture of thermoplastic polymer film
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To constitute the title method so that a peripheral speed of a rotary cooling body is improved, by a method wherein an auxiliary electrode which is comprised of a conductive material, about in parallel with the rotary cooling body and not grounded is provided at least on one side of a main electrode. CONSTITUTION:A wiry main electrode 5 is provided between a rotary cooling body 2 and die 1 in parallel with the rotary cooling body 2, the main electrode 5 is connected with a plus side of an electric source 8 and the rotary cooling body 2 is grounded. Platelike auxiliary electrodes 6, 6' are provided on both sides of the main electrode 5 in parallel with the rotary cooling body 2 and the auxiliary electrodes 6, 6' are not grounded. A molten thermoplastic polymer is extruded through the die 1 and molded on the surface 3 of the rotary cooling body 2 as a film 4. In this instance, high voltage is applied to the main electrode 5, corona discharge is generated between the main electrode 5 and the rotary cooling body 2 becoming an opposed electrode, static charge is imparted to the film 4 and stuck close to the surface 3 of the rotary cooling body 2. With this construction, the film 4 is cooled and solidified by the rotary cooling body 2. Therefore, a rotary speed of the rotary cooling body 2 is quickened remarkably and productivity is improved.

docs.title: Method of inspecting thin dyestuff film
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of inspecting a thin dyestuff film which is capable of easily inspecting the state of the thin dyestuff film when the surface of a substrate formed with grooves at prescribed intervals is coated with the thin dyestuff film. SOLUTION: The correlation between the light intensity ratio of two beams of diffracted light varying in order selected form the diffracted light by the surface of the thin dyestuff film 204 formed on the substrate 202 formed with the grooves at the prescribed intervals and the physical quantity indicating the relation between the dyestuff film thickness in the groove sections and the dyestuff film thickness in the non-groove sections between the groove sections and the groove sections is previously determined;  The light intensity of at least two beams of the diffracted light varying in the order of diffracted light by the surface of the thin dyestuff film 204 formed by coating on the substrate 202; the measured light intensity ratio of the light intensity of the diffracted light is calculated; and the state of the thin dyestuff film is inspected from the physical quantity corresponding to the calculated light intensity ratio based on the correlation previously determined.

docs.title: 溶液制膜装置及方法
docs.abstract: 本发明提供能够抑制生产效率的降低、并且防止厚度不均的溶液制膜装置及方法。在溶液制膜装置(10)中，经由下述步骤来制造膜：通过将胶浆(12)流延到带(30)上而形成流延膜(14)的流延膜形成步骤；使流延膜(14)一边干燥一边移送至剥取位置的移送步骤；和在剥取位置处将流延膜(14)从带(30)上剥取的剥取步骤。在移送步骤中，从通过干燥箱(64)而覆盖的内侧区域(74)抽吸溶剂气体，一边促进流延膜(14)的干燥，一边将溶剂气体供给至遮风板(68、70)与带(30)的间隙，从而阻止新鲜风流入至内侧区域(74)中。

docs.abstract:

【課題】溶液製膜法により製造したフイルムを偏光板な どに加工したときに、フイルム剥がれが生じないフイル ムを製造する最適条件を設定する。

ゴム栓及びゴム栓の製造方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】自動打栓適性があり、滅菌時に抜けてしまうことがなく、薬液へのゴム栓の成分の溶出がなく、薬液を密封可能であり、かつ、薬液の使用時には取り外しやすいゴム栓及びゴム栓の製造方法を提供する。 【解決手段】ゴム栓１４は、栓本体４１と、フィルム４２を備える。栓本体４１はゴム製であり、プレフィルドシリンジ１０のルアーノズル１６に嵌合する形状を有し、ルアーノズル１６の先端面２１に当接する第１当接部３１と、ルアーノズル１６の側面２２に当接する第２当接部３２とを有する。フィルム４２は、第１当接部３１を被覆する第１被覆部４２ａと、第２当接部３２を被覆する第２被覆部４２ｂとを有する。フィルム４２は、エチレン四フッ化エチレン共重合体からなり、第１被覆部４２ａが第２被覆部４２ｂよりも厚い。 【選択図】図４

docs.title: 聚酯薄膜及聚酯薄膜的制造方法、偏振片以及图像显示装置
docs.abstract: 本发明提供一种聚酯薄膜及聚酯薄膜的制造方法、偏振片以及图像显示装置。满足下述式(1)～(4)的聚酯薄膜能够使偏振片加工工序以及涂布工序等后工序中的薄膜断裂极少。0≤C S ＜0.003L 2 /8W……(1)；0≤C CT ＜0.003L 2 /4W……(2)；0.8≤W≤6.0……(3)；20≤L≤30……(4)，式(1)～(4)中，C S [单位：m]表示薄膜的总宽圆弧的值，C CT [单位：m]表示薄膜宽度方向中央位置的半裁圆弧的值，W[单位：m]表示薄膜宽度，L[单位：m]表示测定总宽圆弧及半裁圆弧时的薄膜长度。

docs.title: 溶液製膜方法及び溶液製膜設備
docs.abstract: 【課題】ドープの吐出口の全幅領域に渡って異物の付着を抑制し、良好な面状のフィルムを製造する。 【解決手段】ポリマーと溶剤とを含むドープを複数種類用意し、フィードブロックの内部で所望の配置となるよう合流させた後、連続して走行させた支持体５４の上に流延ダイ５１のスリット出口８５から共に流出させて、外層６１ｂ，６１ｃの間に基層６１ａを配した複層の流延膜６１を形成する。スリット出口８５付近に流れる風９０を遮るように、流延ダイ５１に対して支持体５４の走行方向下流側に、スリット出口８５と略同等以上の幅を持つ遮風部材５３を設置して、遮風部材５３と流延ダイ５１との間に閉塞エリアを形成させる。閉塞エリア内に風９０を滞留させて溶剤ガス濃度を高く維持することで、ドープの乾燥を防止し、スリット出口８５の全幅領域に渡って異物の付着を抑制する。 【選択図】図３

docs.title: テープの熱処理方法および巻癖付テープの製造方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】巻き玉表面の温度の追従性を向上させるとともに、巻き玉の置き場所や部位の違いによる品質のばらつきを減少させることができるテープの熱処理方法および巻癖付テープの製造方法を提供する。 【解決手段】ハブにテープを巻回して作製した巻き玉の周囲の環境温度を所定温度まで昇温させる昇温工程と、前記所定温度下で前記巻き玉を一定時間熱処理する熱処理工程と、を備えるテープの熱処理方法であって、前記昇温工程において、前記巻き玉の周囲の環境の相対湿度を４０％以下にするとともに、昇温速度を０．６℃／ｍｉｎ以下にする。 【選択図】図４

docs.title: Ink jet recording method, writing head and recorder
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a high image quality, high productivity ink jet recorder having a high drying speed in which blur is suppressed, reproducibility of gradation is improved and ejecting direction is stabilized. SOLUTION: The writing head 1 comprises an ink chamber 2 having an opening, a pressure generating means 4 disposed in the ink chamber 2 and being driven based on an image data signal, a bias electrode 3 for applying an electrostatic field to ink in the ink chamber 2, a bias voltage control section for applying a voltage to the bias electrode 3, means 7 for irradiating the ink 6 with light wherein the ink 6 is produced by dispersing particles into a solvent.

docs.title: Ink jet head, recorder employing it, and recording method
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an ink jet head capable of forming an image with a high image quality by cutting ink well at the time of ink ejection thereby ejecting an ink drop having predetermined size stably in a specified direction, and to provide a recorder and a recording method employing it.  <P>SOLUTION: The ink jet head comprises an ejection opening plate having at least one ink ejection opening, a substrate provided at a specified interval from the ejection opening plate to form an ink chamber between the substrate and the ejection opening plate, a structure existing in the ink ejection opening, and an ink ejecting means for ejecting ink wherein the inner wall face of the ejection opening is lyophilic to the ink at least partially.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: 電気音響変換器
docs.abstract: 振動板に複数の振動子を配置してなる電気音響変換器において、高音域での音圧低下を抑制し、また、消費電力を低減できる電気音響変換器を提供する。振動板と、振動板の一方の面に配置された複数の圧電振動子からなる振動子群と、を有し、複数の圧電振動子はそれぞれ、第１グループから第ｎグループのいずれかに属し、各グループごとに、圧電振動子に入力される入力信号の周波数帯域の上限周波数が異なっており、各グループにおける上限周波数をｆ 1 ～ｆ n とした際に、第１グループにおける上限周波数ｆ 1 から、第ｎグループにおける上限周波数ｆ n に向かって、上限周波数が漸次、低くなる。

docs.title: ペロブスカイト型酸化物、酸化物組成物、酸化物体、圧電素子、及び液体吐出装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】強誘電性能に優れた新規組成のペロブスカイト型酸化物を提供する。 【解決手段】ペロブスカイト型酸化物は、下記一般式で表されるものである。（Ａ ａ ，Ｂ ｂ ）（Ｃ ｃ ，Ｄ ｄ ，Ｘ ｘ ）Ｏ ３ （Ａ：Ａサイト元素である。Ａ＝Ｂｉ、０＜ａ。Ｂ：１種又は複数種のＡサイト元素である。０≦ｂ＜１．０。Ｃ：Ｂサイト元素である。Ｃ＝Ｆｅ、０＜ｃ＜１．０。Ｄ：１種又は複数種のＢサイト元素である。０≦ｄ＜１．０。０＜ｂ＋ｄ。Ｘ：１種又は複数種のＢサイト元素である。ＣとＤの化学式上の平均価数よりも化学式上の平均価数が大きい元素である。０＜ｘ＜１．０。（Ａサイトの化学式上の平均価数）＋（Ｂサイトの化学式上の平均価数）＞６．０。Ｏ：酸素。Ａサイト元素とＢサイト元素と酸素のモル比は１：１：３が標準であるが、これらのモル比はペロブスカイト構造を取り得る範囲内で基準モル比からずれてもよい。） 【選択図】なし

docs.title: Driving circuit and method of piezoelectric element and liquid discharging device
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a driving circuit and method in which waveform distortion of a driving signal is avoided when a large number of piezoelectric elements are driven simultaneously while avoiding increase in power consumption when the piezoelectric element is driven, and to provide a liquid discharging device.  <P>SOLUTION: A number of nozzles extracting section extracts the number of nozzles to be driven at the same timing, and one or a plurality of filter circuits are selected out of three filter circuits 126, 128 and 130 provided in a feedback loop 116 depending on the number of nozzles thus extracted. Since the cut-off frequency of the filter circuit in the feedback loop 116 is altered in accordance with the number of nozzles to be driven at the same timing, impairment in ejection characteristics due to a variation in the number of nozzles to be driven at the same timing can be avoided.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Ink jet recorder
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an ink jet recorder having no possibility of error ink dis charge by providing a specific flow path resistance generation part in an ink flow path which supplies an ink to an ink discharge part made of a slit-form space. CONSTITUTION:In a head body 4, an ink flow path is formed by a supply port 20 and an ink containing part 1. Because the gap of the supply port 20 is set larger than that of the ink containing part 1 to a large extent, the ink containing part 1 forms a flow path resistance generation part in the ink flow path. Therefore, where L(m) is a length of the flow path resistance generation part made of the ink containing part 1 along an ink flow direction and G(m) is a gap of the flow path resistance generation part, these values are determined so that a value G<3>L<-1> meets a relation 10<-12G<3>L<-110<-8>.

docs.title: 液体吐出ヘッド及び脱気処理方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】液体吐出ヘッド（圧力室）内における気泡発生を抑制し、吐出異常を防止する液体吐出ヘッド及び脱気処理方法を提供する。 【解決手段】圧力室５２の天面を形成する振動板５６の圧力室５２と反対側に圧電素子５８が形成され、振動板５６の圧力室５２と反対側には共通液室５５が形成される。共通液室５５の側面５５Ａには支持体１２２で囲まれた気体透過性膜１２０が配設される。気体透過性膜１２０のインクと接触する面の反対側に設けられたチャンバ１２４に負圧を発生させると共通液室５５内のインクから溶存気体が除去される。気体透過性膜１２０は共通液室５５の上面に配設してもよいし、複数の面に配設してもよい。また、共通液室５５内に支持柱１２６を設けることで、共通液室５５（印字ヘッド５０）の剛性低下が防止される。 【選択図】  図８

docs.title: 圧電フィルムおよび積層圧電素子
docs.abstract: 繰り返しの摺動に対して十分な耐久性を有する圧電フィルム、および、圧電フィルムを積層してなる積層圧電素子の提供を課題とする。撓性を有し、圧電体層と、圧電体層の両面に設けられる電極層と、電極層を覆う保護層とを有する圧電フィルム、および、圧電体層と、圧電体層の両面に設けられる電極層と、電極層を覆う保護層とを有する、可撓性を有する圧電フィルムを、複数層、積層してなる積層圧電素子において、少なくとも一方の表面に、摩擦係数が０．１５以下である潤滑層を有することにより、課題を解決する。

docs.title: Semiconductor device and manufacture thereof
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To contrive the simplification of the manufacturing process of a semiconductor device and the improvement of the yield of the device by a method wherein a protective film covering a sensor part and a gate insulating film of a thin film transistor are formed of the same layer. CONSTITUTION:In a semiconductor device manufactured by laminating a sensor part formed in such a way as to hold a photoelectric conversion layer 3 between lower and upper electrodes 2b and 4 and a thin film transistor on the same substrate, a protective film covering the sensor part and a gate insulating film 5 of the transistor are formed of the same layer. Thereby, after the sensor part is formed, the transistor can be formed and the sidewalls of the layer 3 of the sensor part can be protected with the film 5.

docs.title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To implement high reliability, by forming an insulating film on the surface of a substrate having a step part, flattening the surface of the insulating film with a silicon oxide film by a spin-on-glass method, performing etch back, and removing a part of the silicon oxide film and a part of the insulating film. CONSTITUTION:On a silicon substrate 1, on which element regions are formed, an aluminum thin film is formed. Thereafter, a wiring layer 2 is formed. Then, a silicon dioxide film 3, in which phosphorus is doped, is deposited as an interlayer insulating film. Thereafter, the silicon substrate is set on a spinner, and a silicon oxide film 4 is formed by a spin-on-glass method. Then, etching back is performed by a reactive ion etching method, and the silicon oxide film 4 and the protruded part of the PSG film 3 are removed. A contact hole 5 is provided in the PSG film 3. An aluminum thin film is deposited and a wiring layer pattern 6 is formed. Thus, wire breakdown and poor contact are decreased, and the highly reliable device can be obtained.

docs.title: 電子システム及びプログラム
docs.abstract:
【課題】実際の使用状態に応じた機械式電磁リレーの残寿命を把握可能とする。 
【解決手段】ＣＰＵ３１は、コイル４１への通電により接点部４２の接続が機械的に切り替わるような構成となっている機械式電磁リレー３３の接点部４２を動作させた回数である接点動作回数と、コイル４１に加えた印加電力の指標とを用いて機械式電磁リレー３３の残寿命を算出し、算出した機械式電磁リレー３３の残寿命をユーザに通知する。 
【選択図】図３

docs.title: Evaporation source for vacuum evaporation
Member for display device and method for manufacturing the member, and display device
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To suppress overdevelopment accompanying an increase in the number of sheets for development and to suppress changes in pattern dimensions.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for manufacturing a display device member includes: a transfer process of transferring a pattern onto a support by using a photosensitive transfer material having a thermoplastic layer, an intermediate layer and a photosensitive resin layer stacked in this order on a temporary support; an exposure process of exposing the layer transferred to the support; and a developing process of developing the layer after the exposure. The method is characterized in that the developing process includes a second step of forming a pattern made of the photosensitive resin layer and a third process of removing a development residue, and further includes a rinsing process, at least between the second process and the third process, of removing a process liquid used in a preceding process.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Electronic equipment
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide electronic equipment wherein the reference-potential line of its circuit board can be connected electrically with its housing by a simple configuration.  <P>SOLUTION: A circuit board 21 inserted into a housing 11 is covered with a conductive protecting sheet 23. The protecting sheet 23 has a protruding portion 27 in the vicinity of its fastened portion to the circuit board 21. There is provided in the housing 11 a conductive guide rail 50 for guiding the circuit board 21 when inserting the circuit board 21 into the housing 11, and in a portion of a lower guide 53 constituting the rail, an elastically deforming portion 53c capable of deforming it elastically up and down is formed integrally with the lower guide 53. In the state of the circuit board 21 being stored in the housing 11, the elastically deforming portion is so squeezed into the housing as to contact it strongly with the protruding portion 27 of the protecting sheet 23.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: Microstructure production method and microstructure
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a microstructure production method by which a domain where honeycomb structure of pore array is formed is extended without utilizing a mold and the microstructure obtained by the method.  <P>SOLUTION: The microstructure production method for obtaining the microstructure having an aluminum substrate and an anodically oxidized coating film present on the surface of the aluminum substrate and having micropores comprises: an electrolytic treatment step (A) for performing DC-electrolyzing using the aluminum substrate as an anode in an acidic aqueous solution having 30-99 mass% concentration at 30-130°C with a fixed voltage selected from 2-1,000 V and an anodic oxidation treatment step (B) for carrying out the anodic oxidation treatment with voltage equal to that in the electrolytic treatment step (A) in this order.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Inspection method
docs.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inspection method that detects a faulty opening even in arrangement in which the opening has no translational symmetry for a base material having a filled opening being filled by other material and the faulty opening being not filled by the other material among a plurality of openings.SOLUTION: An inspection method detects a faulty opening for a base material having a filled opening being filled by other material and the faulty opening being not filled by the other material among openings in arrangement not having translational symmetry. The method comprises the steps of: acquiring position information of the filled openings and acquiring a centroid position of the filled openings; determining a scan setting range for one filled opening and a setting number of centroid positions included in the scan setting range; fitting the scan setting range for each filled opening for the filled openings being in an inspection region and calculating a number of centroid positions in the inspection range fitted by the scan setting range; and obtaining a difference between the number of the centroid positions included in the inspection range and the setting number of the centroid positions of the scan setting range and defining the number of the faulty openings using the number of the centroid positions of the difference.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an ink composition which makes it possible to fix a high quality image rapidly at a low temperature and is excellent in hot offset resistance and blocking resistance and an inkjet recording method.  <P>SOLUTION: The ink composition contains a dispersion medium and charged particles containing at least a colorant. docs.title: Inkjet recording method and apparatus
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inkjet recording method, and an apparatus by which a desired dot diameter can be obtained even when a plurality of inks are applied, and at the same time, the ink can be formed at a high adhesion degree even when a recording medium is coated paper.  <P>SOLUTION: This inkjet recording apparatus 1 includes: a processing fluid applying part 12 which applies a processing fluid containing a flocculant on the recording medium 22; a drawing part 14 which applies the plurality of inks which contain a pigment particle (A), a dispersion agent polymer (B) for covering the pigment, and a self-dispersing polymer fine particle (C), where the total amount (B+C) of the polymer component occupies one half or more amount to the total solid component amount (A+B+C), and at the same time, which have different total solid component amounts to the recording medium 22; and a drying part 16 which makes solvents contained in the plurality of inks volatilize. docs.title: 電気音響変換器
docs.abstract: 振動板に複数の振動子を配置してなる電気音響変換器において、高音域での音圧低下を抑制し、また、消費電力を低減できる電気音響変換器を提供する。振動板と、振動板の一方の面に配置された複数の圧電振動子からなる振動子群と、を有し、複数の圧電振動子はそれぞれ、第１グループから第ｎグループのいずれかに属し、各グループごとに、圧電振動子に入力される入力信号の周波数帯域の上限周波数が異なっており、各グループにおける上限周波数をｆ 1 ～ｆ n とした際に、第１グループにおける上限周波数ｆ 1 から、第ｎグループにおける上限周波数ｆ n に向かって、上限周波数が漸次、低くなる。

docs.title: Polymer composite piezoelectric body and piezoelectric film
docs.abstract: Provided are a polymer-based piezoelectric composite material and a piezoelectric film having piezoelectric conversion characteristics stabilized by suppressing a change in piezoelectric conversion efficiency in various humidity environments. The polymer-based piezoelectric composite material is a polymer-based piezoelectric composite material including piezoelectric particles in a matrix containing a polymer material, in which a pore volume per unit area is in a range of 0.01 µL/mm<sup>2</sup> to 1.7 µL/mm<sup>2</sup>, which is acquired in a manner that a mercury penetration amount of a sample obtained by cutting a polymer-based piezoelectric composite material in a thickness direction and cutting out the polymer-based piezoelectric particle into a size of 12.5 mm × 25 mm is measured by a mercury penetration method, and the penetration amount is divided by an area of a cross-section of the sample.

docs.title: Liquid composition for inkjet, ink set for inkjet, liquid composition tank for inkjet, ink tank for inkjet and method and equipment for inkjet recording
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an ink set for inkjet which is excellent in blurring and long-time storage stability, an ink tank for inkjet and a method and equipment for inkjet recording and to provide a liquid composition for inkjet which is used for these, and a liquid composition tank for inkjet.  <P>SOLUTION: The liquid composition for inkjet contains at least an organic acid having a ring-shaped structure, an organic compound having the ring-shaped structure, a water-soluble solvent and water. The ink set for inkjet using the liquid composition, the liquid composition tank for inkjet, the ink tank for inkjet and the method and the equipment for inkjet are provided.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Hollow needle for medical use
docs.abstract: A hollow needle (1) for medical use has a cylindrical shape in which a needle tip (10) is formed on a tip side (TS). When the direction along an axis (9) of the cylinder, extending from the tip side (TS) to a base side (BS), is treated as an axial direction (SD), and the direction along the circumference of the cylinder is treated as a circumferential direction (PD), three or more pointed sections (11) that taper toward the tip side (TS) are formed in the needle tip (10) with intervals therebetween in the circumferential direction (PD), and cutting blades (12) that are recessed toward the base side (BS) are formed between each of the three or more pointed sections (11). Recess bottom sections (13) that are located furthest to the base side (BS) in each the three or more cutting blades (12) are formed in different locations in the axial direction (SD).

docs.title: Magnetic recording medium and its production
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a magnetic recording medium in which the durability is enhanced and the clogging of a head is improved and a method for manufacturing it. CONSTITUTION:The magnetic recording medium is obtained by providing a magnetic layer including metallic magnetic powder and coupling agent on one surface on a non-magnetic supporting body and a back layer on the other surface. Besides, the residual solvent quantity of the magnetic layer is <=5mg/m<2>. In order to achieve it, drying is executed by using a far infrared heating device while a magnetic field is oriented.

docs.title: Magnetic recording medium
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a high-quality magnetic recording medium which is balanced overall in performance by forming the recording medium into the combined structure of a thin-film magnetic layer consisting of an iron nitride system, projecting parts, org. protective layer and back layer. CONSTITUTION:A primer coating layer 2 is formed by dispersing fine particles into an org. binder and is formed with rugged shapes 2a. The projecting parts can be formed on the respective layers provided on the primer coating layer 2 by the rugged shapes 2a. The thin-film magnetic layer 3 consisting of the iron nitride system is provided on the primer coating layer 2 and an org. lubricating layer 4 having lubricity is laminated thereon. The back layer 5 having 200-2,000Angstrom  surface roughness is provided on the opposite surface of a plastic base 1. The coefft. of friction of a magnetic tape is lowered by the effect of the projecting parts 4a formed on the outermost layer based on the rugged shapes 2a and the friction resistance is also lowered by the protective layer 4 having lubricity, by which the tape traveling property, durability, wear resistance and corrosion resistance are improved. The degradation in the head touch property generated by tape oscillations, etc., is suppressed.

Image recording material and recess and projection forming method
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a high quality image recording material by which recesses and projections in a sub-micron (1 μm or less) range are formed on at least part of an image surface after image recording, reflected light is reduced, visibility is improved, and uniformity and deepness can be added to the image, and to provide a recess and projection forming method using the image recording material.  <P>SOLUTION: In the image recording material, at least part of an image surface after image recording has recesses and projections which have oblique faces inclined from the bottom of the part, the heights of the recesses and projections are 50 nm or more, and intervals between the recesses and projections are 500 nm or less. The recess and projection forming method includes a heating process in which at least part of the image surface of the image recording material after image recording is heated, and a recess and projection transfer process in which a mold member whose surface has recesses and projections is pressed onto the heated image surface, thereby transferring the recesses and projections that have a height of 50 nm and more and an interval of 500 nm or less.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: Process for producing a magnetic material and magnetic medium containing the same
docs.abstract: ABSTRACT OF THE DISCLOSURE           A ferromagnetic material having a high coercive force and good squareness ratio prepared by mixing an aqueous solution at least containing a salt of a metal capable of forming a ferromagnetic material with a solution of a reducing agent containing at least one of a boron hydride compound or a derivative thereof to perform an oxidation-reduction reaction, wherein the mixing of the solutions is after adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution of the metal salt to about 3.0 or less, and the pH of the reaction mixture at the end of the reaction is adjusted to at least about 3.0 or higher.

docs.title: Magnetically recording medium and its manufacture
docs.abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the durability, running property, and weatherability by installing a lubrication layer on a coating layer of inorganic particles and binder formed on one surface of non-magnetic base body, and a magnetic metallic film having a film of metallic oxide to the other surface of the non-magnetic base body. CONSTITUTION:A non-magnetic base body J coated with a coating layer S on one surface is put into a treatment chamber with glow discharger 3 and the surface of the base body J for vapor deposition is cleaned. Then, the base body J is brought into a magnetic metallic film vapor deposition chamber 4 and a magnetic metallic film A is formed on the base body j, by heating and evaporating a magnetic substance evaporating source 18 by means of electron beam type heating means 16 composed of an electron gun and power source. Thereafter, the base body J is exposed to a plasmatic atmosphere in an oxidizing treatment chamber 5 and the surfac of the magnetic metallic film A is oxidized and a metallic oxide layer B is formed. Finally, the base body J is put into a lubrication layer vapor deposition chamber 6 and a lubrication layer C of a desired thickness is formed on the opposite side of surface of the base body J, coated by said magnetic metallic film is not formed in a lubrication layer vapor deposition chamber 6.

docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a piezoelectric film excelling in both piezoelectric performance and a withstand voltage without: requiring an intrinsically-unnecessary film as a piezoelectric element of an orientation control layer or a protective film; or requiring a complicated process.  <P>SOLUTION: In this piezoelectric element 1, a lower electrode 20, this piezoelectric film 30 and an upper electrode 40 are sequentially laminated on a substrate 10. The piezoelectric film 30 has a surface roughness value P-V of not more than 170.0 nm, which is defined by a difference between a maximum height (peak value P) and a minimum height (valley value V) on a film surface, a piezoelectric constant d<SB>31</SB>greater than 150 pc/N and a breakdown voltage of 80 V or more, which is defined by an applied voltage that results in a current value of 1 μA or more.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Piezoelectric element and method for manufacturing piezoelectric element
docs.abstract: The present invention provides a highly stable piezoelectric element operating at high efficiency, and a method for manufacturing such a piezoelectric element. According to one aspect of the present invention, a piezoelectric element (10) has a laminated structure in which a first electrode (14), a first piezoelectric film (16), a second electrode (18), a bonding layer (20), an intermediate layer (22), a third electrode (24), a second piezoelectric film (26), and a fourth electrode (28) are laminated in the stated order on a silicon substrate (12). The intermediate layer (22) is made of a material different from that of the second electrode (18), the thickness of the intermediate layer (22) being 0.4µm or greater and 10 µm or less. A portion of the silicon substrate (12) is removed, and a device having a diaphragm structure or a cantilever structure is formed. The respective layers (14-28) laminated on the silicon substrate (12) can be formed by a thin-film-forming method such as vapor phase epitaxy.

docs.title: Multi-frequency ultra wide bandwidth transducer
docs.abstract: Piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducer (pMUT) arrays and techniques for frequency shaping in pMUT arrays are described, for example to achieve both high frequency and low frequency operation in a same device. The ability to operate at both high and low frequencies may be tuned during use of the device to adaptively adjust for optimal resolution at a particular penetration depth of interest. In embodiments, various sizes of piezoelectric membranes are fabricated for tuning resonance frequency across the membranes. The variously sized piezoelectric membranes are lumped together by two or more separate electrode rails, enabling independent addressing between the two or more subgroups of sized transducer elements. Signal processing of the drive and/or response signals generated and/or received from each of the two or more electrode rails may achieve a variety of operative modes for the device, such as a near field mode, a far field mode, and an ultra wide bandwidth mode.

docs.title: Piezoelectric ultrasonic transducer array with switched operational modes
docs.abstract: Switchable micromachined transducer arrays are described where one or more switches, or relays, are monolithically integrated with transducer elements in a piezoelectric micromachined transducer array (pMUT). In embodiments, a MEMS switch is implemented on the same substrate as the transducer array for switching operational modes of the transducer array. In embodiments, a plurality of transducers are interconnected in parallel through MEMS switch(es) in a first operational mode (e.g., a drive mode) during a first time period, and are then interconnected through the MEMS switch(es) with at least some of the transducers in series in a second operational mode (e.g., a sense mode) during a second time period.

docs.title: Piezoelectric element and its manufacturing method
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of manufacturing a piezoelectric element which can prevent faults by internal defects and holes.  <P>SOLUTION: Fine particles, each of which is a raw material for the piezoelectric element, are sintered to make an ingot consiting of a fine particle sintered body. Then, the ingot is sliced into a plate-like piezoelectric body 206, which is then ground and thinned into a piezoelectric plate. The piezoelectric plate is divided into piezoelectric elements. When sintering the fine particles, a cavity 210 remains and will become an internal defect or hole of the piezoelectric element. In order to avoid this, the sliced plate-like piezoelectric body 206 is dipped in an insulating liquid 304. Since the plate-like piezoelectric body 206 is a fine particle sintered body, the insulating liquid 304 permeates along the grain boundaries of the fine particles 202 (304A) and thereby the cavity 210 is filled with the insulating liquid 304 (304B). Then, the plate-like piezoelectric body 206 with its cavity 210 now filled up with the insulating liquid 304 is taken out of the insulating liquid 304 and is heated to solidify the insulating liquid 304. Thus, the internal defect or hole of the piezoelectric element is filled up with the insulating liquid 304, preventing a decline in piezoelectric characteristics of the piezoelectric element.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

docs.title: Piezoelectric element manufacturing method and liquid ejection head manufacturing method
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a piezoelectric element manufacturing method for producing a desirable piezoelectric element by the epitaxial growth method such as the sputtering method or the oriented growth method, and to provide a liquid ejection head manufacturing method.  <P>SOLUTION: A lower electrode 14 is formed in a film on a top face 12 of a substrate 10, a piezoelectric film 16 is formed on the lower electrode 14 by the sputtering method, and an upper electrode 18 is formed in a film on the top face of the piezoelectric film 16. Thereafter, a wiring layer is formed to join a flexible cable 34. In this state, after an AC electric field of not smaller than a coercive electric field is impressed, a positive voltage is applied to the upper electrode 18 making the lower electrode 14 the ground, and an electric field is applied to the piezoelectric film. Hence a polarization direction of the piezoelectric film 16 which is a direction from the lower electrode 14 to the upper electrode 18 can be reversed, and the piezoelectric element 20 can be deformed in an ejection direction by applying a positive voltage to the upper electrode 18 making the lower electrode 14 the ground. Processing of polarization reversing of the piezoelectric film can be carried out even when what cannot stand application of a high temperature and a high pressure is present.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Piezoelectric element and ink jet head
docs.abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To sufficiently relax a stress generated between a substrate and a piezoelectric film by arranging an adequate intermediate layer for fulfilling a proper condition.  <P>SOLUTION: The piezoelectric element comprises a substrate consisting mainly of a silicon (Si) or an oxide silicon (SiO<SB>2</SB>), the intermediate layer formed on the substrate, a first electrode layer formed on the intermediate layer, a piezoelectric layer formed on the first electrode layer by a lead-based piezoelectric material, and a second electrode layer formed on the piezoelectric layer. The thickness of the intermediate layer plus the first electrode layer is not less than 15% of that of the piezoelectric layer.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

docs.title: Perovskite oxide, oxide composition, oxide material, piezoelectric element, and liquid discharge device

docs.title: 圧電素子
docs.abstract: 【課題】圧電特性を良好に維持し、かつリーク電流を抑制することが可能な圧電素子を提供する。 【解決手段】基板（１１）上に、下部電極（１２）、圧電体膜（１３）、密着層（１４）、および上部電極（１５）をこの順に備える圧電素子（１０）であって、圧電体膜（１３）が、（１００）面に優先配向したペロブスカイト構造を有し、組成式Ｐｂ［（Ｚｒ ｘ Ｔｉ １−ｘ ） １−ｙ Ｎｂ ｙ ］Ｏ ３ で表される複合酸化物であり、式中、ｘは０＜ｘ＜１であり、ｙは０．１０≦ｙ≦０．１３であり、かつ、Ｘ線回折法によって測定されたペロブスカイト（１００）面からの回折ピーク強度Ｉ （１００） とペロブスカイト（２００）面からの回折ピーク強度Ｉ （２００） の比であるＩ （２００） ／Ｉ （１００） が、０．８５≦Ｉ （２００） ／Ｉ （１００） ≦１．００であり、かつ、密着層（１４９）が、イオン化エネルギー０．３４ｅＶ以下の金属を含む圧電素子（１０）とする。 【選択図】図３

docs.title: 圧電積層体、圧電素子及び圧電積層体の製造方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】圧電定数が高いことに加えて、動作環境における圧電特性の安定性（長期信頼性）に優れた圧電積層体及び圧電素子を提供する。 【解決手段】下部電極層１２と、Ｐｂ含有ペロブスカイト型酸化物を含む圧電膜１５とをこの順に備えた圧電積層体５を有する圧電素子１であって、圧電膜１５は、構成元素の酸素として、質量数が１８の酸素原子 １８ Ｏを、自然存在比を超えて含む。圧電積層体５のペロブスカイト型酸化物は、Ｐｂに加え、Ｚｒ、Ｔｉ及びＯを含むことが好ましい。 【選択図】図１

docs.abstract: 【課題】チタン酸ストロンチウムに高濃度でＲｈがドープされてなるペロブスカイト型酸化物とその製造方法を提供する。 【解決手段】本発明のペロブスカイト型酸化物は、下記一般式（Ｇ）で表されるものである。 Ｓｒ ａ （Ｔｉ ｙ ，Ｒｈ ｘ ）Ｏ ｃ   ・・・（Ｇ）、 但し、式中、ＳｒはＡサイト元素、Ｔｉ及びＲｈはＢサイト元素であり、 ０．１＜ｘ≦０．５である。ａ＝１、ｘ＋ｙ＝１、ｃ＝３が標準値であるがペロブスカイト構造を取りうる範囲内で標準値からずれてもよい。 【選択図】図２

docs.title: 圧電アクチュエータ
docs.abstract: 圧電アクチュエータは積層された複数の圧電膜と、圧電膜の間及び両端面のそれぞれに配置された電極を有する圧電素子と、駆動回路とを備え、複数の圧電膜はそれぞれ２つの抗電圧の絶対値が異なる非対称な分極－電圧ヒステリシス特性を有し、駆動回路は、複数の圧電膜のうちの少なくとも１層に自発分極の向きと同じ向きの電界を生じさせ、他の圧電膜に自発分極の向きと逆向きの電界を生じさせるユニポーラ電圧波形を印加する駆動回路であり、ユニポーラ電圧波形において絶対値が最小である最小電圧値Ｖ１は、他の圧電膜のバイポーラ分極－ヒステリシス特性を示すヒステリシス曲線における０［Ｖ］での傾きＴ０と、前記最小電圧値Ｖ１［Ｖ］での傾きＴ１との比が｜Ｔ０／Ｔ１｜≧１．５を満たすように設定されている。

docs.title: 圧電素子及びそれを用いる液滴吐出ヘッド並びに圧電素子の製造方法
docs.abstract: 【課題】圧電特性が高く、かつ耐久性の高い圧電素子を提供すること。 【解決手段】印加される電圧の変化により伸縮する圧電体膜と、圧電体膜の一方の面に配置された第１の電極と、圧電体膜の第１の電極が配置された面とは反対側の面に配置された第２の電極とを有し、圧電体膜は、気相成長法によって第２の電極上に形成されたＰｂ ｘ Ｂ ｙ Ｏ ｚ を主成分とし、前記第２の電極との接触面から、前記第１の電極の方向に１００ｎｍ離れた部分のｘ／ｙを０．８以上１．６以下であり、Ｂが、Ｔｉ，Ｚｒ，Ｖ，Ｎｂ，Ｔａ，Ｃｒ，Ｍｏ，Ｗ，Ｍｎ，Ｓｃ，Ｃｏ，Ｃｕ，Ｉｎ，Ｓｎ，Ｇａ，Ｚｎ，Ｃｄ，Ｆｅ，Ｎｉ及びランタニド元素の少なくとも１つで構成されており、かつ、０＜ｘ≦１、０＜ｙ≦１、２．５＜ｚ≦３とすることで上記課題を解決する。 【選択図】図１

docs.title: 圧電アクチュエータの製造方法、液体吐出ヘッド、及び画像形成装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】電体膜の膜剥離を防止しつつ、圧電特性を向上させる。 【解決手段】上部電極膜と下部電極膜との間に圧電体膜が設けられてなる圧電アクチュエータの製造方法であって、下部電極膜上に一般式ＡＢＯ ３ （但し、Ａは、Ｐｂ及びＢａのうちの少なくとも一方を含み、Ｂは、Ｚｒ及びＴｉのうち少なくとも一方を含む。）で示されるペロブスカイト型の結晶構造を有する圧電体膜を成膜した後、酸素雰囲気中で前記成膜時に前記圧電体膜に加えた温度以下で前記圧電体膜をアニール処理する工程を含むことを特徴とする圧電アクチュエータの製造方法を提供することにより、前記課題を解決する。 【選択図】  図２

docs.title: ペロブスカイト型酸化物とその製造方法、圧電体、圧電素子、液体吐出装置
docs.abstract: 【課題】圧電性能に優れたペロブスカイト型酸化物を提供する。 【解決手段】下記一般式（Ｐ）で表される組成を有するペロブスカイト型酸化物の製造方法において、下記式（１）及び（２）を充足する条件で、組成を決定する。   （Ｂａ，Ｂｉ，Ａ）（Ｔｉ，Ｆｅ，Ｍ）Ｏ ３ ・・・（Ｐ）、   ０．９８≦ＴＦ（Ｐ）≦１．０２・・・（１）、   ＴＦ（ＢｉＦｅＯ ３ ）＜ＴＦ（ＡＭＯ ３ ）＜ＴＦ（ＢａＴｉＯ ３ ）・・・（２） （式（Ｐ）中、Ｂａ，Ｂｉ，及びＡはＡサイト元素、Ｔｉ，Ｆｅ，及びＭはＢサイト元素。Ａ及びＭは、Ｐｂを除く各々１種又は複数種の金属元素である。式（１），（２）中、ＴＦ（Ｐ）は上記一般式（Ｐ）で表される酸化物の許容因子、ＴＦ（ＢｉＦｅＯ ３ ）、ＴＦ（ＡＭＯ ３ ）、及びＴＦ（ＢａＴｉＯ ３ ）はそれぞれ（）内に記載の酸化物の許容因子である。） 【選択図】なし

docs.title: タイヤ内電力発生装置及び該装置を用いたタイヤモニタリングシステム
docs.abstract: 【課題】非鉛系タイヤ内電力発生装置において高い発電能力を実現する。 【解決手段】タイヤ内電力発生装置２は、下記一般式（ＰＸ）で表されるペロブスカイト型酸化物からなる（不可避不純物を含んでもよい）無機圧電体を含む圧電部２０と、圧電部２０がタイヤに加えられる外力により歪むことにより、圧電部２０に発生する電荷を取り出す一対の電極（２１，２２）と、取り出した電荷を蓄積するエネルギー蓄積部２３とを備えている。   （Ｂｉ ｘ ，Ａ １−ｘ ）（Ｂ ｙ ，Ｃ １−ｙ ）Ｏ ３ ・・・（ＰＸ）   （式（ＰＸ）中、ＡはＰｂ以外の平均イオン価数が２価のＡサイト元素、Ｂは平均イオン価数が３価のＢサイト元素，Ｃは平均イオン価数が３価より大きいＢサイト元素であり、Ａ，ＢおよびＣは各々１種又は複数種の金属元素である。Ｏは酸素。Ｂ及びＣは互いに異なる組成である。０．６≦ｘ≦１．０、ｘ−０．２≦ｙ≦ｘ。） 【選択図】図１Ａ
